# Package Types

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List package types

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types`

Retrieve a paginated list of package types with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, creator | `company` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by | `architecto` |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by package type name | `Box` |
| `filter[barcode]` | string | No | Filter by barcode | `PKG` |
| `filter[company_id]` | string | No | Filter by company IDs | `architecto` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types?include=company&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Box&filter%5Bbarcode%5D=PKG&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types?include=company&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Box&filter%5Bbarcode%5D=PKG&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types?include=company&filter%5Bid%5D=architecto&filter%5Bname%5D=Box&filter%5Bbarcode%5D=PKG&filter%5Bcompany_id%5D=architecto&sort=-created_at', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create package type

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types`

Create a new package type

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Package type name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `length` | number | Yes | Length. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `width` | number | Yes | Width. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `height` | number | Yes | Height. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `base_weight` | number | Yes | Base package weight. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `max_weight` | number | Yes | Maximum package weight. Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 99999999999. |
| `barcode` | string | No | Package type barcode. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "Box L",
  "length": 40,
  "width": 30,
  "height": 20,
  "base_weight": 1.5,
  "max_weight": 25,
  "barcode": "PKG-TYPE-001",
  "company_id": 1
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/package-types", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "Box L",
  "length": 40,
  "width": 30,
  "height": 20,
  "base_weight": 1.5,
  "max_weight": 25,
  "barcode": "PKG-TYPE-001",
  "company_id": 1
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```
